mentions.name: aiexpo.app
mentions.description: A directory of 1,600+ AI tools organized across 70+ categories. Users can compare tools, filter by category, read reviews, and find free alternatives. Coverage spans AI chatbots, image generators, coding tools, video tools, and AI agents, with the directory updated daily as new tools launch.
mentions.problem: Searching for AI tools was frustrating because they were scattered across dozens of different sites.
